premises.text: Car repair forces owners into shop trips, borrowed rides, and risk of being ripped off
premises.evidence_span: don't waste your time going to a shop, begging friends for a ride, and then hoping and maybe praying that you don't get ripped off

premises.text: Customers book online in under 60 seconds with transparent prices vs dealers/shops, ratings, and seven-day scheduling at home or office
premises.evidence_span: you can take care of your car problems in less than 60 seconds

premises.text: Symptom search plus on-site inspection via mobile app produces an on-the-spot estimate when owners do not know what is wrong
premises.evidence_span: Simply go online and say, smoke from the car. We'll immediately tell you what are the possible reasons

premises.text: Integration with the three largest North American parts suppliers and half a billion labor/parts data points yields a fixed fair price with no shady markups
premises.evidence_span: We are fully integrated with the three largest car parts suppliers in North America. We have half a billion data points on labor time and parts

premises.text: Independent mechanics with their own tools can perform about 80% of repairs and earn more while customers save versus shop rates
premises.evidence_span: all of us mechanics own our own scanners and tools to perform about 80% of all car repairs

premises.text: Target is out-of-warranty cars older than five years in a large annual repair spend market
premises.evidence_span: There are 200 million cars on the road that are older than five years

value.text: Mechanics fix your car at your location with a fixed fair price and a better repair experience
value.evidence_span: This awesome mechanic, Mike, will fix your car at your home, your office, or wherever you are

secondary_value.text: Mechanics make more while customers save
secondary_value.evidence_span: When you hire me through your mechanic, you save money, I make more, and everyone wins

causal_links.evidence_span: And this allows us to give you a fixed, fair price every time
